ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast profile; visible surface area composed of approximately 85% high-intensity white pixels and 15% low-intensity black pixels concentrated on the trailing margins and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white high-intensity region centrally. Low-intensity black border along the entire trailing edge boundary. Three distinct vertical black linear streaks on the left lobe. Dense mottling cluster of dark pixels at the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 65 degrees, depth extending significantly into the visible vertical axis of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations; jagged saw-tooth boundary with pixel-amplitudes between 4 and 15 pixels, appearing most concentrated on the lateral distal margins of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Complex curve exhibiting proximal convexity near the median notch, transitioning to a slight mid-lobe concavity, and ending in convex lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of high-contrast white circular pixel groups (barnacle colonization) located on the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three discrete, near-vertical black linear marks on the white surface of the left lobe, ranging in pixel length from 20 to 55 pixels.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dark pigmentation mottling and irregular pixel clusters localized around the perimeter of the median notch and the trailing edge transition zones.
other_distinctive_markers: Protruding calcified biological attachments (barnacles) creating a non-linear, irregular 3D profile along the extreme distal edges of both fluke lobes.
